name: design-engineering
description: Design engineering for AI agents — animation timing, transitions, typography, color, components, layout, accessibility, anti-patterns, sound, SVG, launch films. Plus a SOUL.md identity layer and ten workflow subagents. Distills Emil Kowalski, Benji Taylor, Jakub Antalik (transitions.dev), guidelines.sh, Vercel, Ben DC, DiceBear, lucide-animated, Google Labs design.md, Agentation.
